newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan financials rise sharply in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan financials rise sharply in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan's financial shares rose sharply in late trade on Monday as investors found little room for gains in other sectors following the market's recent rise, brokers said.
With 40 minutes of trade remaining, financials had gained 1.01 percent compared to the overall index's rise of 0.63 percent.
Shin Kong Life soared 4.07 percent or T$4.50 to T$115. China Development Corp was up T$1.50 to T$92 on heavy volume of 29 million shares.
Heavily weighted financials had stayed relatively quiet during the market's previous four sessions of gains. The index hit a six-year high on Saturday.
Electronics, which led the recent rally, suffered from some profit-taking on Monday, rising only 0.34 percent.
"The other sectors are hitting a short-term ceiling, so investors have turned their attention to financials," said Lin Long-hsien, an analyst for United Securities.
"As long as financials can support the market, the index should remain strong," Lin added.
